ValidationRule.description: Bounds must be positive and ordered, a multiplier must be greater than zero, and a dollar upcharge cannot be negative.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Quantity_Lower_Bound__c < 1, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Quantity_Upper_Bound__c)), Quantity_Upper_Bound__c < Quantity_Lower_Bound__c), AND(ISPICKVAL(Upcharge_Type__c, "Multiplier"), Value__c <= 0), AND(ISPICKVAL(Upcharge_Type__c, "Dollar"), Value__c < 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Check the quantity range and value: the lower bound must be at least 1, the upper bound cannot be below the lower bound, a multiplier must be greater than 0 and a dollar amount cannot be negative.
